hypotheses.hypothesis: A typed consume-bound provenance contract can eliminate a class of cross-branch stale/substituted/replayed identity failures more cleanly than independent ad-hoc guards.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The apparent commonality is superficial; forcing one abstraction across boot, capabilities, rewards and datasets may create complexity without reducing branch-specific failure probability.
hypotheses.falsifier: Implement only the minimal shared typed fields/verification semantics in a test harness and compare against independent branch-local guards on stale/substitution/replay fault matrices, latency and implementation complexity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frank v0.1 product boot should be treated as the first consume-bound provenance boundary: exact executable, source/package root, Python flags/import graph and private SQLite identity must be attested before real token-API/runtime imports become admissible.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The final packaged binary may not use repository-local Python imports, making source-root machinery unnecessary and potentially harmful.
hypotheses.falsifier: Resolve the canonical real product entrypoint and run its exact dependency graph under V4; add no project root unless the graph proves it necessary.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exactly-once learning should be implemented as deterministic consumption of a unique producer-bound terminal-receipt identity, preferably without a second mutable persistence architecture.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: A mutable RewardConsumption ledger is simpler and safer under crash/retry than recomputing a canonical unique-set fold.
hypotheses.falsifier: Crash-after-plasticity-before-ack, retry, rollback-resurrection and duplicate-delivery differential between unique-set fold and ledger under current UnifiedDB recovery semantics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GWT causal identity must be producer/storage-bound before re-entry and learning; caller-carried episode/signal/causal IDs are insufficient.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Additional storage enforcement duplicates V17 provenance and adds latency without incremental protection.
hypotheses.falsifier: Compose the #280-style successor with exact episode/signal/causal splice controls; truthful reaches DONE while every splice fails before REENTERED.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heldout integrity requires two separate authorities: deterministic manifest lineage and independently verified semantic-contamination audit; a hash binding to an unverified audit is not enough.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Protected dynamic/OOD evaluation may provide more value than building a heavy semantic-audit authority layer for v0.1.
hypotheses.falsifier: Compare static manifest+audit, protected dynamic/OOD, and combined protocols on seeded semantic leakage families and operational cost.
